purpose: Research-only timing grade per river. Not read by the app. Source data: research/trip-times/AZ.json (paddle-guide tables) + agency multi-day durations.

grades.sourced: dated trip report or agency guide with time+distance on a catalog section
grades.loosely-supported: agency guide gives days only (no hours) or off-section/undated

recommendations.defer: hide time until a real trip is logged

salt-river-lower.refFlowBasis: USGS 09502000 newest instantaneous discharge at check time (2026-10-25T21:00:00+00:00 UTC), not a typical-season value
salt-river-lower.note: refSpeedMph 3.0 is an unsupported placeholder required by the schema; hide float-time estimates for this river until real trip timings exist.
